log: note 'Instant wire: @OUT rises in the same tick as @IN, 40 blocks away; it falls 12 ticks after IN (re-arming)'
label IN 0 2 2 'input: a stone behind the head piston; power it'
label OUT 37 1 2 'output: wire, rises in the head'"'"'s tick'
label CUT 37 2 0 'the stone over the output step while armed'
group instant_wire 0 1 -1 39 2 2 in @IN IN out @OUT OUT
label LREP 0 2 4 'test lever behind the repeater'
target new instant 'lever on IN at 10: the head moves at 11, and the whole chain with it: OUT and the first stage change at 11'
target new same_tick 'a repeater powers IN: OUT rises in the tick the repeater turns on (12), 0 ticks after it'
target new rearm 'IN on at 10 (OUT 11), off at 30: OUT off at 42, after the chain has re-extended; on again at 44 (OUT 45)'
target new too_soon 'failure case: IN back on 10 ticks after it went off, while the tail'"'"'s stone is still moving: the tail spits it onto the step, and OUT goes off while IN is on'
target new short_pulse 'failure case: a 2-tick pulse on IN makes the head spit its block: the chain stays down (OUT on) until IN has been on and off again'
